GameplayEvent Rules8 sections
How to Play

◆ In Dungeon Dev, players battle to repair the different levels of a dungeon.

◆ Players must strategically position their monsters to repel intruding adventurers and repair the dungeon.

Level Completion

◆ In each level, groups of adventurers will try to break through the dungeon's gate. You will lose if you let the adventures breach the gate.

◆ If you manage to protect the gate and defeat all the adventurers, you will complete the level.

Monsters

◆ Some monsters unlock at the event start, and more will unlock as you progress through Main Quest levels.

◆ Monsters vary in type—some specialize in attacks and others in support. They also have various shapes, so plan their placement wisely.

◆ Monsters can combine into stronger monsters; each monster can combine up to 5 times, and each fusion increases its power substantially. Their power will reset after completing the level.

◆ You can level up your monsters in the Monster Den page using Monster Fragments. Upgrading increases their base attributes and may unlock new talents.

Backpack

◆ The Backpack grid is the place where you arrange your monsters for battle. Only monsters in the Backpack can participate in battles.

◆ The Backpack starts with a 3 x 3 dimension. As players progress through battle waves, they can unlock new slots to expand their setup capacity for positioning more monsters.

◆ The Backpack size resets after completing a level, so players have to expand it again in the next level.

Sweep

◆ The Quick Operation function unlocks by progressing through the Main Quest. Players can use this function to collect rewards from the Main Quest quickly.

◆ The rewards obtained by Sweeping relate to the Main Quest progress—the more progress made, the more rewards you receive.

Guild Stamina Ranking Rules

◆ Transcenders earn guild points when consuming stamina during the event.

◆ The points generated are with the Transcender; if the Transcender transfers to a new guild during the event, the points from the old guild are deducted, and the new guild gains the corresponding points.

◆ The guild stamina ranking is settled at the end of the event, and Transcenders must be in a guild at that time to receive rewards.

◆ Transcenders eligible at the settlement period can claim their leaderboard rewards, which are sent via email.

Guild Refresh Tablet Usage Ranking Rules

◆ Transcenders earn guild points when consuming refresh table during the event.

◆ The points generated are with the Transcender; if the Transcender transfers to a new guild during the event, the points from the old guild are deducted, and the new guild gains the corresponding points.

◆ The guild refresh tablet usage ranking is settled daily at 24:00 during the event, and Transcenders must be in a guild at that time to receive rewards.

◆ After the settlement period, daily ranking rewards are sent via email.

Disbanding, Kicking and Leaving Rules

◆ Disbanding a guild, kicking guild members or leaving a guild are not allowed during the two hours before the event ends and within 10 minutes after the event ends.

G
Guild Ranking

◆ Transcenders earn guild points when consuming stamina during the event.

◆ The points generated are with the Transcender; if the Transcender transfers to a new guild during the event, the points from the old guild are deducted, and the new guild gains the corresponding points.

◆ The guild stamina ranking is settled at the end of the event, and Transcenders must be in a guild at that time to receive rewards.

◆ Transcenders eligible at the settlement period can claim their leaderboard rewards, which are sent via email.

◆ Transcenders earn guild points when consuming refresh table during the event.

◆ The guild refresh tablet usage ranking is settled daily at 24:00 during the event, and Transcenders must be in a guild at that time to receive rewards.

◆ After the settlement period, daily ranking rewards are sent via email.

G
Guild Ranking

◆ Transcenders earn guild points when consuming stamina during the event.

◆ The points generated are with the Transcender; if the Transcender transfers to a new guild during the event, the points from the old guild are deducted, and the new guild gains the corresponding points.

◆ The guild stamina ranking is settled at the end of the event, and Transcenders must be in a guild at that time to receive rewards.

◆ Transcenders eligible at the settlement period can claim their leaderboard rewards, which are sent via email.

◆ Transcenders earn guild points when consuming refresh table during the event.

◆ The guild refresh tablet usage ranking is settled daily at 24:00 during the event, and Transcenders must be in a guild at that time to receive rewards.

◆ After the settlement period, daily ranking rewards are sent via email.

G
Guild Ranking

◆ Transcenders earn guild points when consuming stamina during the event.

◆ The points generated are with the Transcender; if the Transcender transfers to a new guild during the event, the points from the old guild are deducted, and the new guild gains the corresponding points.

◆ The guild stamina ranking is settled at the end of the event, and Transcenders must be in a guild at that time to receive rewards.

◆ Transcenders eligible at the settlement period can claim their leaderboard rewards, which are sent via email.

◆ Transcenders earn guild points when consuming refresh table during the event.

◆ The guild refresh tablet usage ranking is settled daily at 24:00 during the event, and Transcenders must be in a guild at that time to receive rewards.

◆ After the settlement period, daily ranking rewards are sent via email.
